eventTypes.hit: BANS_GSSweepCheck window: spheres (radius m) around each bone/socket in 'bones' (radii per entry) are swept every frame; id/effectIds = FUStSkillEffectDesc rows applied on hit
eventTypes.warning: BANS_GSAttackWarnning: pre-hit warning volume (perfect-dodge / AI reaction check), same shape format as hit
eventTypes.superArmor: BANS_GSSetSkillSuperArmor window: poise level (DescID) - not interrupted by hits below that level
eventTypes.comboWindow: BANS_GSComboWindow: AI may chain the next skill
eventTypes.attackState: BANS_GSAttackState: the unit is in attack state
eventTypes.rotate: BANS_GSAttackRotation: may turn toward target at speed deg/s
eventTypes.speedRate: BANS_GSSetAMSpeedRate: montage play rate multiplier inside the window
eventTypes.moveScale: BANS_GSCalcAMScale: root-motion scaling along axis to reach the target (pureScale, or rate clamped to min/max with moveOffset m)
eventTypes.buff: BANS_GSAddBuffByID: buff active during the window (FUStBuffDesc id)
eventTypes.jumpSectionIfBuff: jump to montage section when the unit has buffId
eventTypes.bullet: BANS_GSSpawnBullets: projectile/AoE id spawned at socket
eventTypes.effect: BAN_GSTriggerEffect: FUStSkillEffectDesc id triggered at time
eventTypes.behavior: BAN_GSNotifyBehaviorGraph tag sent to the AI graph
eventTypes.movementMode: BANS_GSSwitchMovementMode (e.g. MOVE_Flying for jumps: vertical root motion applies)
eventTypes.collision: collision profile/channel changes (e.g. ignore pawn = pass through player)
eventTypes.stoneSkin: stone skin transition curve (铜头铁臂 / turn-to-stone visual) on mesh or hair
eventTypes.sound: Wwise event name at time, attached to a bone/socket
eventTypes.vfx: Niagara system name, socket; window for timed effects
eventTypes.block: BANS_GSAutoCheckBlock: auto-block (铜头铁臂 deflect) window using the BlockInfoConfig asset
eventTypes.materialFx: BANS_DispLibTimedModifyMaterial: timed material parameter change on tagged components (e.g. hair opacity)
eventTypes.bodyCollisionScale: BANS_GSHitMoveCollisionScale: body collision capsule resized along a curve
eventTypes.destroyProjectile: BAN_GSDestroyProjectileByID: removes spawned projectiles by id
